tagline.en_US: Read and organize RSS feeds with a lightweight web-based feed reader.

description.en_US: Miniflux is a minimalist, lightweight feed reader that supports RSS, Atom, and JSON Feed formats. It organizes articles using categories and bookmarks, and offers full-text search across content. The application prioritizes privacy by removing tracking parameters, blocking external scripts, and sanitizing article content. It provides a clean, responsive interface optimized for readability and keyboard navigation.
